title: Public project presentation resolver
purpose: Resolve one explicitly public Sesh project together with optional canonical public creator presentation without exposing internal creator identity.
boundaries: SESH_DB only
No session
No RIVER_IDENTITY_DB
No SESH_AUDIO
No R2 public access
Project must have explicit public publication state
Publication owner must equal canonical project owner
Creator lookup uses internal ownerCreatorId only after project/publication agreement
Internal ownerCreatorId is never returned
Internal SeshCreatorId is never returned
Creator presentation is emitted only when canonical reservation and profile agree
No reservation means project remains public without creator attribution
No creator profile means project remains public without creator attribution
Reservation/profile identity contradiction fails closed as unavailable
Storage failure fails closed as unavailable
No rights, copyright, publishing, distribution, management, royalty, licensing, label, collaboration, CRM, account, or identity grants
No mutation
No migration
No HTTP route introduced
Existing public project JSON API remains unchanged
Existing public project page remains unchanged in SESH-052
